discussion.body: Ending moved. Thesis unchanged: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, Asteria scarred and standing. It plays at the end of Act 13 inside the Deep Maze Fissure, which the Act 7 cataclysm opened and which Acts 8-11 give you time to prepare for. Variations still do not fork a second cinematic: Bengenia wipe, graves, Velith/Vortan fate, clean vs cracked Sigils, which personal epilogues exist. Open-world completion can add optional scenes before the rail lock, not extra endings.
